map_note: Schlegel, Finkbeiner & Davis 1998 E(B-V) at each object's Galactic (l, b), read from the local dustmaps SFD files (~/data/dustmaps/sfd). Every coefficient is A_band / E(B-V)_SFD.
correction: flux_corrected = flux * 10**(0.4 * R * E); variance_corrected = variance * 10**(0.8 * R * E). Applied to native fluxes before the luptitude transform.
legacy_north_rule: decals_dr9_north g, r, z: the DESI North->South relation acts on UNcorrected magnitudes; extinction is then removed in the DECam (south) system. Because the relation is linear in magnitudes, this equals correcting the north bands with R_eff = H_north[:, latent grz] @ R_DECam[grz], computed from the observation operator at preparation. The listed values are DECam fallbacks only.

legacy_dr9.reference: Legacy Surveys DR9 catalogue documentation, Galactic extinction coefficients (DECam ugrizY 3.995 3.214 2.165 1.592 1.211 1.064; WISE W1-W4 0.184 0.113 0.0241 0.00910; BASS/MzLS computed as if on the DECam system; SFD98 map)

sf11.reference: Schlafly & Finkbeiner 2011, ApJ 737, 103, Table 6, R_V = 3.1, per E(B-V)_SFD. VHS J,H,Ks use the UKIRT (MKO-like) J,H,K rows as an approximation to VISTA filters.

skymapper.reference: Wolf et al. 2018, PASA 35, e010, Table 1 (R_band from F99, R_V = 3.1)

computed.reference: SF11 method reproduced (F99 R_V=3.1, 7000 K blackbody, scale 0.8828 fitted to 16 SF11 Table 6 rows: residual rms 0.73%, max 1.81%) with top-hat bandpasses: DECam VR 5000-7600 A, VISTA Y 9700-10700 A. Top-hat bandpasses overestimate broad filters (PS1 w +5.5%); treat VR as +/-5%. Filter curves could not be downloaded (SVO unreachable); edges are nominal values, unverified.
